description: Filtered list of dysfunctions. Filter by axis, self_report reliability, confidence, or category. Every entry carries its reliability and review signals, its everyday-term aliases and its unit of analysis.

axis.description: Filter by current taxonomy axis (2-10). axis=10 returns all eleven axis-10 entries (10.1-10.3 and the hybrid sub-category 10.4, 10.6-10.9, 10.11-10.13); add category to narrow to one sub-category. Before 0.1.0a11 an axis filter excluded hybrids unless category was set.

self_report_reliability.description: Filter by the exact self_report reliability value.

name: list_dysfunctions
